summary.text: David Ray represents District 69 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, part of Pulaski and Faulkner counties, and is serving his third term; he first served in 2021.

paragraphs.text: Ray is a consultant and communications strategist who was Chief of Staff to Lieutenant Governor Tim Griffin from 2017 to 2020 and U.S. Senator Tom Cotton's communications director on his 2014 campaign.
Ray is a former state director of Americans for Prosperity - Arkansas and has a B.S. in Communication and Political Science from the University of the Ozarks. He lives in Maumelle.
